_lisez_moi: Text of the guided-steps questions (public/js/parcours.js). Same keys as src/contenu/fr/parcours.json.

activite.aide: Tick your trades and your customers. We turn them into the opening sentence of the memorandum; you review it just below.
activite.pourquoi: It’s the first thing a buyer reads: your trades, your products or services, your customers.

metiers.aide: Pre-ticked from your website and your business code. Untick what’s wrong.

description.libelle: The proposed sentence for the memorandum
description.aide: Written from your choices: edit it freely.

distinctions.titre: What sets you apart from your competitors?
distinctions.aide: One to three answers. A buyer looks for what makes the company hard to copy.
distinctions.pourquoi: Without an answer, the chapter shows “To be completed”.
distinctions.chapitre: 2.2 Business and know-how; key strengths in the summary

certifications.aide: Optional. Quoted as is in the memorandum.

histoire.aide: The registries already give us some dates. Add the milestones that matter: acquisition, expansion, new trade, key hire.
histoire.pourquoi: The memorandum’s timeline: it shows the company’s continuity.

equipe.titre: Can your team run day to day without you?
equipe.pourquoi: The buyer wants to know what depends on you: that’s what they will have to take over or organize.

encadrement.libelle: Is there a management layer in place?

clients.pourquoi: Customer concentration and recurrence are closely examined by every buyer.

part_premier_client.libelle: Share of revenue from your largest customer

principaux.libelle: Your top five customers, with no names

remuneration.titre: What needs adjusting in your accounts
remuneration.aide: A buyer reasons on “normal” earnings: your pay at market rate, without events that won’t happen again.
remuneration.pourquoi: The gap with normal pay and one-off items are EBITDA adjustments, and therefore affect the value.

remuneration_dirigeant_reelle.libelle: What you cost the company per year
remuneration_dirigeant_reelle.aide: Salary and payroll taxes, or management fees and contributions.

remuneration_normative.libelle: What a manager replacing you would cost
remuneration_normative.aide: If you don’t know, keep the suggestion: it doesn’t change the valuation.

exceptionnel_signale.libelle: Did a one-off expense or income affect your latest accounts?
exceptionnel_signale.aide: For example: a dispute, an insurance claim, a one-time grant.

detention.aide: A buyer always asks two questions: who are they buying the shares from, and are they also buying the premises?
detention.pourquoi: The legal structure chart and the scope; an unusual rent is adjusted.

detention.libelle: How do you hold your shares in the company?

murs_cession.libelle: Are the premises part of the sale?

loyer_paye.libelle: Annual rent paid by the company

loyer_marche.libelle: Annual market rent for equivalent premises
loyer_marche.aide: If you don’t know, keep the suggestion: no adjustment.

operation.pourquoi: Scope, timeline and transition support, presented without any price. Support reassures the buyer about keeping the customers and the know-how.

part_cedee.requis: the share of the capital being sold

perspectives.titre: How do you see the next 5 years?
perspectives.aide: An average annual estimate is enough; it’s presented as yours.
perspectives.pourquoi: The growth drivers a buyer could pursue.

croissance.aide: The slider starts from the average growth in your accounts, when it’s known.
